parameters.edge_filter: merge each homolog edge then require at least10cM; union eligible edges
parameters.ibd0_exclusion: all detected IBD between siblings, including short edges
parameters.mask: union of all participating individuals' HBD at each fixed cutoff
parameters.zero_exposure: IBD011 ratio, numerator and denominator are zero; union remains measurable
parameters.selection: single fixed diagnostic; all results reported, no outcome-selected feature/model variant
parameters.scope: training only fitting, four separate calibration cohorts, exposed8 development only

limitations: DRUID motivates observed multiway sharing; human degree results do not validate exact dog labels with inbreeding.
